hotspots.evidence: Gln244Pro -> resistance to SglPP7 and SglM
Lys46 sits in the hydrophilic central cavity, is essential for flippase activity, and is the anchor that acidic Sgl residues reach.
Arg270 is essential, is proposed to bind the lipid II diphosphate, and rotates to bridge Glu96 of SglCJ3.
Arg53 is functionally important, forms a coevolving pair with Glu273 that stabilises the squeezed state, and contacts the C-terminal carboxylate of SglPP7 and SglCJ3.
Lys368 forms a thin gate with the conserved G/A-E-G-A motif and contacts the C-terminal carboxylate of the peptides.
